name: Romantic sublime

influenced_by: Edmund Burke's writing on the sublime (1757)

garments: not a fashion look — a landscape-painting movement

media.title: Caspar David Friedrich, Wanderer above the Sea of Fog (1818)

reacts_against: Enlightenment rationalism's faith in order and measurement, favoring awe, scale and the overwhelming power of nature instead.

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Nature (especially untamed, wild, and sublime), ruins, the medieval past, folk traditions, nationalism, heroism, the supernatural, exoticism, dreams, intense emotion (awe, horror, terror)
wiki_facts.key_values: Emotion and intuition over reason, individualism, imagination, subjectivity, transcendence, freedom

findings: dark — about 41% of the measured color across 6 wiki photos is below mid-lightness
mostly muted — about 50% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
